Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: General
Strand: Natural and the Built Environments
Topic 1.2: Main physical features in Eastern Africa
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Main physical features in Eastern Africa, part of Natural and the Built Environments in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six General.

Key inquiry question: How can we conserve physical features that are found in our locality? 2. Why are physical features important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

● Learning to learn: Learners carry out activities as they brainstorm in pairs the main physical features in Eastern Africa.

● Digital Literacy: Learners use digital devices to describe the formation of the main physical features in Eastern Africa.

Values:
 Unity: Learners display team spirit as they discuss in groups and identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa.

 Integrity: Learners display discipline as they use digital devices to describe the formation of the main physical features in

Eastern Africa.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

 Environmental Education: Learners discuss ways of conserving the physical features within the locality to promote

environmental education.

 Cooperation and Unity: Task oriented grouping as learners discuss in groups and identify the main physical features in

Eastern Africa.

Links to other Learning Areas:
 Learners use Creative Arts knowledge as they draw a map of Eastern Africa, locate the main physical features, and display

in class.

 Learners use English, Kiswahili and Kenyan sign language skills as they brainstorm, in pairs the main physical features in

Eastern Africa.
